title: Diverse by Reasoning: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds for Future Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.24001v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for future prediction, motivating the use of multiple models as a wisdom-of-the-crowd mechanism. However, simply increasing crowd size does not guarantee effective diversity, as different LLMs may exhibit redundant behaviors. We propose a behavior-aware framework for constructing diverse LLM crowds. The framework characterizes models using their reasoning traces on independent development tasks, clusters models by behavioral similarity, and selects representatives for collective prediction. We evaluate 25 LLMs using seven development benchmarks for behavioral diversity modeling and two future-prediction benchmarks for evaluating diverse crowds' performance. translated_title: 通过推理实现多样性：利用LLM群体的智慧进行未来预测
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于未来预测，这促使人们使用多个模型作为一种“群体智慧”机制。然而，仅仅增加群体规模并不能保证有效的多样性，因为不同的LLM可能表现出冗余行为。我们提出了一种行为感知框架，用于构建多样化的LLM群体。该框架通过独立开发任务上的推理轨迹来表征模型，根据行为相似性对模型进行聚类，并选择代表性模型进行集体预测。我们使用七个开发基准对25个LLM进行行为多样性建模，并使用两个未来预测基准评估多样化群体的性能。我们的结果表明，群体组成可能比群体规模更重要：基于K-means++行为聚类的三模型中心点群体，在两个预测基准上均优于对所有25个模型进行传统投票的方法，同时减少了计算开销。
tldr: 本文提出一种行为感知框架，通过聚类LLM的推理轨迹选择代表性模型，证明小而多样化的群体比大规模冗余群体更能提升未来预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a behavior-aware framework that clusters LLMs by reasoning traces to select representative models, showing that small diverse crowds outperform larger redundant ones in future prediction.
